headline: Info Edge (India) Limited acquisition disclosed under SEBI Regulation 30
sum: Info Edge (India) Limited disclosed an acquisition to the NSE under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR 2015 on 24 June 2026, but the target company identity, consideration, and material terms remain unconfirmed in publicly available corroborating sources.
implication: Regulation 30 disclosure is mandatory for listed entities within 30 minutes of material information; the absence of contemporaneous press release or exchange confirmation in public sources suggests either the filing is recent/embargoed or the transaction scope remains subsidiary and may not trigger broader disclosure thresholds.
detail: Info Edge (India) Limited, a Mumbai-listed internet platform company operating Naukri.com and other vertical platforms, filed a Regulation 30 intimation with NSE on 24 June 2026. The filing references transfer of assets or stake between IEIL and an entity marked SIHL. No corresponding BSE filing, press release, or financial-press reporting of the transaction with specific value, target identity, or regulatory approvals has been located.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 — Regulation 30
framework.note: Central — mandates material information disclosure to stock exchanges within 30 minutes for listed entities; acquisition is a category of material event.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 — Regulation 25(1)
framework.note: Threshold for disclosure of material acquisitions (>25% stake or >₹100 cr consideration); status of this transaction against threshold unknown.
If the acquisition involves a scheme of arrangement, shareholder approval under these sections may be required.
If target is overseas-domiciled, overseas direct investment limits and RBI approval may apply.
If combined enterprise turnover or asset thresholds are breached, CCI notification under Section 6 (now Section 5) may be required.
Acquisition may qualify for tax-neutral treatment under Section 47(vi) or similar, depending on transaction structure.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 — if applicable
framework.note: If acquisition crosses 25% voting stake in listed target, open offer and disclosure under these regulations may apply.

triggers.note: Mandatory material information disclosure within 30 minutes to stock exchange.
